::: {#thm-distributive}
#### Distributive laws

For propositions $A$, $B$ and $C$:

1. $A \land (B \lor C) \equiv (A \land B) \lor (A \land C)$;
2. $A \lor (B \land C) \equiv (A \lor B) \land (A \lor C)$.

:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

Law 2 is @sol-or-distributes.
For law 1, the fourth and fifth columns of this table match in every row:

| $A$ | $B$ | $C$ | $A \land (B \lor C)$ | $(A \land B) \lor (A \land C)$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | T | T | T | T |
| T | T | F | T | T |
| T | F | T | T | T |
| T | F | F | F | F |
| F | T | T | F | F |
| F | T | F | F | F |
| F | F | T | F | F |
| F | F | F | F | F |

:::

:::
